note: Code measures, Jev weighs. Shop/pack items carry measured_gain: the score change the joker or planet gives on this run's last 10 hands (jokers.py). Through ante 3 joker slots fill before interest (buy a Useful joker regardless of the $25 buffer while under 4 jokers), and any joker measured at +50% is bought. Discard plans carry exact draw odds and the score if they hit (odds.py, order-free deck counts). Boss-aware: debuffed cards are tossed first and never chased; Psychic/Eye/Mouth filter plays; Flint halves estimates; on the last hand, discards are used before a play that can't clear (The Needle). Fixed suit order in deck counts. Builds on v8 (joker-aware estimates, pace gate).
rules: Balatro: reach each blind's chip target before hands run out. A hand scores chips x mult; jokers add chips or mult, or multiply mult (xMult). Discards are free but limited. Interest: $1 per $5 held at round end, max $5 (at $25).

instructions.blind: Should we play or skip the upcoming blind?
instructions.play_now: Should we play our strongest hand (`strongest_play`) now instead of discarding first to build a better one? Compare its estimate with `round.chips_needed_per_remaining_hand`, and weigh hands left, discards left and how likely `deck_remaining` is to improve the hand.
instructions.best_play: Which play is best this turn? `estimated_score` already includes our jokers (except any in `jokers_not_in_estimates`), so it is the real expected score. Prefer the higher score unless a lower one keeps stronger cards or avoids resetting a scaling joker.
instructions.best_discard: If we discard, which plan is best? Each plan gives `chance_to_hit` (exact odds from the cards left in the deck) and what the hand scores `if_hit`, jokers included. Weigh odds times payoff against what we need this round.
instructions.item_value: How much would taking the item in `item` (described in this question) strengthen this run? `measured_gain` is its measured effect on the scores of our recent hands, jokers included: trust it for the immediate effect and add what it cannot see (scaling over the run, money, risk, future hands). Consider `engine.missing`, `upcoming_boss` and what it costs.

options.blind_play: Play the {name} (need {score} chips) and earn its cash reward
options.blind_skip: Skip the {name} to gain the {tag_name}: {tag_effect}. Skipping forgoes the blind's money and shop visit.
